title: Swirling Vortex Gathering
description: A surreal desert landscape at sunset features a large crowd of stylized green figures with yellow hands raised upward from flowing grassy forms. A vibrant spiral vortex of purple, teal, and gold swirls in the sky above, surrounded by bubbles, with green cacti dotting the golden hills.
prompt: Surreal desert scene at sunset with rolling golden hills and scattered green cacti. In the foreground, a large crowd of stylized teal and green humanoid figures with flowing grass-like lower bodies raise their bright yellow hands upward. A large vibrant swirling vortex of purple, cyan, and gold spins in the sky with floating bubbles, distant mountains and a glowing sun on the horizon, whimsical fantasy style, colorful and dreamy atmosphere
